name: Tooltip
summary: A small, dismissible-on-hover, portaled bubble that names a control or clarifies a value. Strictly informational — no actions inside. Triggers on hover-with-intent (700 ms enter / 100 ms leave) and on keyboard focus. Suppressed on touch (a long-press is not a tooltip — use Popover instead). Portaled per AGENTS.md hard rule 10.

content.description: Short label or sentence. Tooltips are not for prose — > 2 lines or any interactive element means you want a Popover.

delayShow.description: Hover-intent delay before showing, in ms. 700 ms is the established Apple HIG / Atlassian tooltip threshold.

delayHide.description: Hide delay after pointer leaves the trigger.

arrow.description: Render a 6 px arrow pointing at the trigger.

kbdHint.description: Optional inline Kbd cluster rendered after the label (e.g. Add task ⌘N). Pair with sentence-case label.

open.description: Controlled override. Use to keep the tooltip pinned during an animation or to suppress during a drag.

rules: Tooltip text MUST also be reachable via the trigger's accessible name when the trigger is icon-only — wire aria-labelledby={tooltipId} so SR users hear the label without depending on hover.

Tooltip content must be dismissible (Escape), hoverable (the user can hover over the tooltip itself), and persistent (does not disappear after a few seconds) — the three WCAG 1.4.13 'Content on Hover or Focus' requirements.
Per AGENTS.md hard rule 10 — the tooltip portals to document.body.
Do not put interactive content inside. If you need a button or a link in the bubble, you want Popover.
Honor prefers-reduced-motion: skip the entry zoom-in; keep the fade.

do: Use for icon-only buttons (the IconButton's accessible name should come from the tooltip).
Use for table column headers when the column label is truncated.
Use for keyboard-shortcut reveal on hover ('Save  ⌘S').
Lead with a sentence-case short label. One line.
If a label needs more than 2 lines or any interactive element, switch to Popover.
dont: Don't put a button, link, or input inside a Tooltip. Use Popover.
Don't paint the bubble in lime — chrome, not action.
Don't show tooltips on touch — they hide content under fingers and contribute to layout instability.
Don't auto-show tooltips on page load — the user must signal intent (hover, focus).
Don't render the bubble inline as <div absolute> — portal to document.body.

changelog.note: Initial Tooltip contract. Hover-intent timing (700/100). Kbd hint slot. Portaled per hard rule 10.
